qa_pairs.question: How do I launch STAR-CCM+ version 18.04.008 or newer in serial graphical mode on an OnDemand desktop session?
qa_pairs.answer: To launch STAR-CCM+ 18.04.008 or newer in serial graphical mode on an OnDemand desktop, first load the `StdEnv/2023` module, then load either `starccm-mixed/21.02.008` or `starccm/21.02.008-R8`, and finally run the command `starccm+ -rr server`.

qa_pairs.question: What commands are required to launch STAR-CCM+ version 18.04.008 or newer in parallel graphical mode on an OnDemand desktop session?
qa_pairs.answer: To launch STAR-CCM+ 18.04.008 or newer in parallel graphical mode on an OnDemand desktop, you need to load the `StdEnv/2023` module, then load either `starccm-mixed/21.02.008` or `starccm/21.02.008-R8`, and finally execute the command `starccm+ -rr server -np 2 -mpi openmpi40`.

qa_pairs.question: How do I run STAR-CCM+ versions 15.04.010 to 17.06.008 in parallel graphical mode within an OnDemand desktop session?
qa_pairs.answer: To run STAR-CCM+ versions 15.04.010 to 17.06.008 in parallel graphical mode on an OnDemand desktop, first load the `StdEnv/2020` module (which is retired), then load either `starccm-mixed/17.06.008` or `starccm/17.06.008-R8`, and finally execute the command `starccm+ -np 2`.
